scope: Bounded parent review of the receiver corrections against effect-delivery-review.json; static evidence only.
result: Both reported receiver-evidence gaps are resolved in source. Runtime acceptance is still pending.

resolved_findings.finding: Observe effect ordering without waiting behind the command mutex
evidence: src/fabric_time/shell.rs:359-370 constructs SchedulerWakeCommit from the actual owned scheduler/capacity fields after scheduler, capacity and Ready publication.
src/fabric_time/tests/adapters/mod.rs:Effects::deliver captures those borrowed actual fields before invoking the selected concrete adapter, rather than acquiring the owner mutex later.

src/fabric_time/tests/adapters/fencing.rs:203-240 deliberately executes each concrete delivery with the same owner's real unpublished Running/Blocked fields, requires the normal receiver predicate to reject it, and then requires normal publication to pass.

resolved_findings.finding: Synchronize denied-delivery checks with the live receiver
evidence: src/fabric_time/tests/adapters/mod.rs:Harness::command, choose and no_delivery compare complete preparation/delivery sequences to consumed deliveries at each non-delivering boundary.
The live receiver acknowledges FIFO checkpoints only after earlier delivery packets and the completed control-unpark confirmation; acknowledgement includes checkpoint and delivery sequences.
Harness::receive_boundary requires positive progress before any control wake; successful Drop checkpoints before Stop. Timeouts bound required progress only, never infer absence.

limits: No new build/test/lint or runtime pass is asserted by this review.
The selected concrete adapter remains an explicitly supplied application-owned mechanism.
Bounded local receiver progress is not global liveness, performance or whole-system correctness.
